title: PARTICIPANT — Participant
description: Core participant registration, consent, birth, blood-sample and demographic fields.

PID.title: Participant ID
PID.$comment: Source gives no coding/nullability signal for this field; treated as always present. Open item -- see DECISIONS.md D004.

REGISTRATION_YEAR.title: Year of registration
REGISTRATION_YEAR.$comment: Bounds are an agent-decided plausibility range (OFH is a modern recruitment, dictionary v14); source states no range. Source gives no nullability/coding signal -- treated as always present, unlike BIRTH_YEAR which the source explicitly marks is_sparse_coding with a Suppressed code. Open item -- see DECISIONS.md D004.

REGISTRATION_MONTH.title: Month of registration
REGISTRATION_MONTH.$comment: Source gives no nullability/coding signal -- treated as always present. Open item -- see DECISIONS.md D004.

CONSENT_VERSION.$comment: Source gives no nullability/coding signal -- treated as always present. Open item -- see DECISIONS.md D004.

CONSENT_YEAR.title: Year of consent
CONSENT_YEAR.$comment: Bounds are an agent-decided plausibility range; source states no range. Source gives no nullability/coding signal -- treated as always present. Open item -- see DECISIONS.md D004.

CONSENT_MONTH.title: Month of consent
CONSENT_MONTH.$comment: Source gives no nullability/coding signal -- treated as always present. Open item -- see DECISIONS.md D004.

BIRTH_YEAR.title: Year of birth
BIRTH_YEAR.$comment: Bounds are an agent-decided plausibility range for adult participants; source states no range. is_sparse_coding=yes in the source dictionary, with a documented Suppressed (-999) code -- adopted verbatim, this is disclosure control, not generic missingness.

BIRTH_MONTH.title: Month of birth
BIRTH_MONTH.$comment: is_sparse_coding=yes in the source dictionary, with a documented Suppressed (-999) code -- adopted verbatim.

BLOOD_SAMPLE.title: Blood sample quality
BLOOD_SAMPLE.x-derivation: Blood sample obtained with sufficient condition and volume for extraction of buffy coat, DNA and plasma.
BLOOD_SAMPLE.$comment: Source coding table defines only 0/1, no missingness code -- treated as always present. Open item -- see DECISIONS.md D004.
